candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately before the final return true (replace the final return value).
Replace the final return true with returning the success flag of the last external call (_s) to change return based on call outcome.
Insert an early unconditional return true before performing any calls, causing the function to return true without invoking calls.

Replace the call invocation using .call with a direct staticcall to make the external call use static context (which will revert if the target attempts to modify state), altering outcome observable via transfer behavior.
Change the call target argument order in the encoded selector so transferFrom is invoked with 'to' and 'from' swapped, altering which account is debited/credited and thus observable transfer effects.
Remove the revert on failed external call and instead continue the loop (no revert), so some failed transfers do not revert the whole call altering final observed state.
